Demo budget app: ASP.NET Core 10 minimal API/EF Core; React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind; Docker Compose. Prefer simple, readable, composable code; clear names over generic Repository, Service, Manager; avoid overexplaining comments. No code comments - use descriptive method/class names instead.
dotnet watch run
dotnet run -p tests/BudgetTracker.Api.Tests --output detailed --filter-query "/path/to/test"
dotnet ef migrations add MigrationName
dotnet ef database update
npm run dev
npm run build
npm run lint
docker compose up -d
docker compose down
Uses Microsoft Testing Platform (not VSTest); snake_case tests: `Should_do_when_something`; integration tests use Testcontainers; prefer NSubstitute.
When one of the applications is started for testing, make sure it's stopped once finished.
